findings.claim: In desktop/topic-post.scss, `.topic-meta-data h5 a` has its dark-light-choose arguments swapped. The original light-theme `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(70%, 30%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`, so the light-theme link becomes much lighter and lower-contrast.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291, `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` sets `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Because `dark-light-choose` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/variables.scss:46-52) returns the first argument on light themes and the second on dark themes, the swapped 70%/30% values make the bold link much lighter and lower-contrast than intended (unlike the matching 30%/70% in app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:14).

findings.claim: In desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss, `.group-member-info .name` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, the same as `.title`.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 and app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497, `.group-member-info .name` is set to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, giving it the same 50% light-theme lightness as `.group-member-info .title` (desktop/user.scss:527 and mobile/user.scss:503). By contrast, user names elsewhere such as app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:15 use `(30%, 70%)` while titles at topic-post.scss:24 use `(50%, 50%)`.

findings.claim: In mobile/topic-post.scss, `.topic-map h3` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(20%, 80%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 20% to 50% and diverges from desktop/topic-post.scss, which keeps 20/80.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182, `.topic-map h3` sets `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `(20%, 80%)`, giving a 50% light-theme lightness. This diverges from app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321, which uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.claim: The comment at common/base/discourse.scss:73 still describes the old default `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`, which is stale after the conversion.

verifier.reason: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:72-73 still states the topic-list table cell default is scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), whereas app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/_topic-list.scss:48-55 and the adjacent .coldmap-* rules at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:75-83 now use dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, ...), scale-color($secondary, ...)).
